description: This file is a shell script that establishes a series of tests for git replay functionality, including setup, rebase, cherry-pick, conflict handling, and configuration options.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a new commit with specified changes

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success

methods.name: test_expect_code
methods.description: Checks that a command exits with a specific code

methods.name: test_write_lines
methods.description: Writes specified lines to a file, used for expected outputs

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files line-by-line, succeeding if they match

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Checks that a file is empty

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for a pattern in a file

methods.name: test_config
methods.description: Sets or verifies git configuration options for testing

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers cleanup commands to run after tests

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the system clock in tests or introduces a delay

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test suite
